Not referenced from any executable code path. Only mentioned in dev-report-c3-20260504-223115.json `files_created[]` (historical record) and qa-report-c3-20260504-223115.json (which itself flagged the naming as inconsistent with orchestrator prompt's `c3-verify-trace.sh` reference). Per inspector rule §4 (one-time scripts), `~/.claude/scripts/check-file-references.sh` would return exit 2 (only historical doc references). Recommendation: archive or delete; user-only since /root/scripts/ is outside happy-dev worktree. Per orchestrator prompt: `/root/scripts/c3-*.sh harnesses were created by C3 dev — flag if any look like debug-only that should be removed.`
